tracks.name: Red Bull Ring
tracks.description: A short, quick lap in the Styrian hills. Three hard stops on the climb to the top of the circuit, then a fast, downhill sweep back through the last two right-handers.

tracks.name: Autodromo Nazionale Monza
tracks.description: The Temple of Speed, in a royal park near Milan. Long flat-out straights, big stops into the chicanes, then Lesmo and the Parabolica. The lowest downforce of any circuit.

tracks.name: Mugello Circuit
tracks.description: Ferrari's own circuit in the Tuscan hills. Climbs and drops all lap, with fast, flowing corners like the two Arrabbiatas, and a long straight that falls away into San Donato.

tracks.name: Autodromo Enzo e Dino Ferrari
tracks.description: Autodromo Enzo e Dino Ferrari, run anticlockwise beside the Santerno river. Narrow and old-school, with chicanes and kerbs that bite at Tamburello, Variante Alta and Rivazza.

tracks.name: Circuit de Spa-Francorchamps
tracks.description: Spa-Francorchamps in the Belgian Ardennes, the longest lap here. Eau Rouge and Raidillon climb the hill to the Kemmel straight, and it can rain at one end and not the other.

tracks.name: Silverstone Circuit
tracks.description: A former airfield and the home of British racing. Very fast: Copse, then the Maggotts, Becketts and Chapel sweepers into the Hangar straight.

tracks.name: Brands Hatch GP Circuit
tracks.description: Kent's natural amphitheatre. The Grand Prix loop drops down Paddock Hill bend, climbs to Druids, then heads out into the woods past Hawthorn and Westfield.

tracks.name: Suzuka International Racing Course
tracks.description: Honda's figure of eight in Japan, the only one that crosses over itself. The Esses, Degner, the Hairpin, Spoon and the flat-out 130R.

tracks.name: Circuit Zandvoort
tracks.description: Among the dunes on the Dutch coast. Narrow and twisty, with steeply banked corners at Hugenholtz and onto the main straight.

tracks.name: Nürburgring GP Circuit
tracks.description: The modern Grand Prix circuit at the Nurburgring, in the Eifel hills. A tight first sector, then fast, flowing stretches and a chicane before the line.

tracks.name: Hockenheimring
tracks.description: The Hockenheimring in Baden-Wurttemberg. A long sweep out to the hairpin, then the slow stadium section in front of the big grandstands.

tracks.name: Circuit de Barcelona-Catalunya
tracks.description: Circuit de Barcelona-Catalunya. A long main straight, the long right of turn 3, and a slow, technical last sector. Hard on the front-left tyre.

tracks.name: Hungaroring
tracks.description: The Hungaroring, in a dusty valley outside Budapest. Tight and twisty with few places to pass, so the grid and the pit stops decide a lot.

tracks.name: Albert Park Circuit
tracks.description: Albert Park, a street circuit around a lake in Melbourne. Fast and flowing, with walls close by and a dusty surface that grips more as the weekend goes on.

tracks.name: Circuit Gilles Villeneuve
tracks.description: Circuit Gilles Villeneuve, on an island in the St Lawrence. Straights and chicanes, very hard on the brakes, and the Wall of Champions waiting at the last one.

tracks.name: Circuit of the Americas
tracks.description: Circuit of the Americas in Texas. A steep climb to the first hairpin, a run of fast esses, then a long back straight and a slow stadium section.

tracks.name: Autódromo Hermanos Rodríguez
tracks.description: Autodromo Hermanos Rodriguez, over 2,200 m up. The thin air cuts downforce and cooling, the straight is very long, and the lap ends in the old baseball stadium.

tracks.name: Autódromo José Carlos Pace
tracks.description: Interlagos in Sao Paulo, run anticlockwise. Downhill through the Senna S at the start, a long uphill run to the line, and rain that can arrive in minutes.

tracks.name: Bahrain International Circuit
tracks.description: Bahrain International Circuit in the desert. Big stops into slow corners, a rough surface that wears tyres, and sand blown onto the track. Often raced into the night.

tracks.name: Yas Marina Circuit (2009-2020)
tracks.description: Yas Marina in Abu Dhabi, past the marina and under the hotel bridge. Long straights, slow corners, and a race that starts in daylight and ends under the lights.

tracks.name: Sepang International Circuit
tracks.description: Sepang in Malaysia. Wide and fast, with two long straights joined by a hairpin. Hot and humid, with storms in the afternoon.

tracks.name: Shanghai International Circuit
tracks.description: Shanghai International Circuit. A first corner that tightens like a snail shell, then one of the longest back straights in racing into a hairpin.

tracks.name: Oulton Park International Circuit
tracks.description: Cheshire parkland. Narrow, up and down, with blind crests and very little run-off. One of the great driver's tracks.

tracks.name: Snetterton 300 Circuit
tracks.description: A Norfolk airfield circuit. Long straights, the tight Brundle and Nelson corners, and the fast Bombhole and Coram on the way back.

tracks.name: Donington Park Grand Prix Circuit
tracks.description: Donington Park in Leicestershire. The swooping downhill Craner Curves, the climb back up to Coppice, and the slow Melbourne hairpin and Goddards to finish.

tracks.name: Cadwell Park Circuit
tracks.description: The mini Nurburgring in the Lincolnshire Wolds. Narrow, steep and twisty, with the famous Mountain where cars go light over the top.

tracks.name: Thruxton Circuit
tracks.description: A Hampshire airfield circuit and the fastest in the UK. Long, flat-out sweeps like Church, then the Complex and the chicane before the line.

tracks.name: Mallory Park Circuit
tracks.description: A short Leicestershire circuit around a lake. The long, fast Gerards bend, the Esses, then hard braking for the Hairpin and Devil's Elbow.

tracks.name: Knockhill Racing Circuit
tracks.description: Scotland's national circuit in Fife. Short, hilly and tight, with blind crests and a slow hairpin. The lap is over in under a minute.
